name: Dr. Varsha Kiron
specialization: Cardiology - interventional cardiology. Diagnostics: transesophageal echocardiography (TEE), coronary and peripheral angiography. Interventions: coronary and peripheral angioplasty, CHIP (complex high-risk indicated patient) angioplasty, intravascular-imaging-guided angioplasty, robotic angioplasty, and structural heart interventions including device closures, TAVR and MitraClip. BAND IS HIGH - TWO GENUINELY INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL SOURCES AGREE. Source 1: AIG Hospitals' own site, https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-varsha-kiron , title 'Dr. Varsha Kiron - Cardiology', on AIG's canonical singular /doctor/ family with a slug matching the assigned name exactly; live, NOT a '404 Page Not Found'. Source 2: the Apollo group (apollo247.com and apollospectra.com), a completely separate hospital company. Per section 5 the Apollo domains count once between themselves, but Apollo and AIG are different organisations, so this is two independent official sources - the condition High actually requires. The corroborating directories (Skedoc, HexaHealth, myUpchar, LogintoHealth, BanglaHealthConnect) were NOT counted toward the band.

HOW THE TWO SOURCES WERE PROVEN TO BE THE SAME MAN - a five-point credential fingerprint, not just a shared name. (a) DM Cardiology from CMC Vellore appears on both. (b) DNB Cardiology appears on both. (c) European Society of Cardiology fellowship appears on both - AIG spells it out as 'International Associate Fellowship in Cardiology, European Society of Cardiology (2021)', Apollo abbreviates it to 'FESC'. (d) ROBOTIC ANGIOPLASTY is the decisive crossover: AIG's page credits him with being part of the team that performed 'the first Robotic angioplasty in AP/Telangana in 2022', and Apollo Health City separately fronted him in a public Facebook Live session titled 'Robotic Angioplasty... with Dr. Varsha Kiron, Consultant Cardiologist at Apollo Hospitals, Jubilee Hills'. A doctor of the same name, same city, same sub-specialty, same CMC Vellore DM, same ESC fellowship AND the same unusual robotic-angioplasty niche is one person. (e) Both describe the same interventional repertoire. NO other 'Varsha Kiron' surfaced anywhere in any query - the name is distinctive and returned a single individual - so there is no ambiguity to resolve and Ambiguous Match is not warranted.

AFFILIATION - IMPORTANT NUANCE FOR THE HUMAN. The workbook assigns him to AIG Hospitals, and his AIG page is live and indexed, so the assigned affiliation is NOT contradicted. But the weight of current evidence points to APOLLO HOSPITALS JUBILEE HILLS as his principal present practice: Apollo 247, Apollo Spectra Kondapur, the Apollo Facebook Live, an Apollo YouTube patient testimonial and myUpchar's Jubilee Hills location all place him at Apollo, and the PERT leadership he is credited with is explicitly 'at Apollo Hospital Jubilee Hills'. The most probable reading is that he has MOVED from AIG to Apollo and AIG has not retired his page - the same page-decay behaviour already documented on AIG rows in this dataset - or, less likely, that he consults at both. Both hospital profiles are recorded rather than one being suppressed, because both are live official pages and the reader needs to see the conflict. hospital_profile holds the AIG page (the assigned hospital, as the workbook expects); the Apollo pages are in other_profiles and drive the appointment_link.
